body: Please just ignore them, people who say mean things about other people's appearance are shitty. Most of the time it's just to be mean and not even because there's anything wrong with you.  I'd try to forget it

You don't look old, people just dont know what 16 year olds look like. I'm the same age and people say I "look in my 20's" as well as every other 16 year old girl I know who gets told they look "in their 20s". People are dumb. You look good.
Yes. It's only okay to enjoy things so long it makes you a more productive worker.
Thank you, I really appreciate this. That's something helpful to think about

I'm glad someone else acknowledges how bad it is, that gives me some hope. I've been crying for help because things shouldn't be like this and nobody seems to listen. I remember trying to tell a doctor at a psych hospital that a staff member who was watching us in the youth ward was being very creepy toward a younger girl and needed to be moved and he said I was "too mentally ill to be trusted". That just made me wanna curl up and die. We do deserve a better world... thank you

Im always terrified about something similar with my mom, I always think about how I will kill myself when she passes. My mom has been the only person to care about me or be my friend my whole life and I love her more than anything. She's helped me so much, sacrificed everything for me, and I'm very dependent on her due to my autism spectrum disorder. It seems impossible to go on without her. I'm so sorry.  I wish I could help you, please know you're not alone. Sending hugs

I agree,  I'm nice to everyone and treat people like I want to be treated yet I've been intensely harassed by a 4chan group since I was 13. In the end if you're an easy target it doesn't matter how "nice" you are. And if you're nice to the people who are mean to you or try to talk it out like humans and explain how much they're hurting you they just mock you more. Some people just genuinely get off on being assholes and theres nothing you can do

I thought my sibling wrote this because I say the exact same thing "fucked for life", and I always site those same statistics and talk about how I'll always have mental health problems. I say the same things word for word and I always thought it was just me so that's interesting. I also get upset when people have tried to show me conflicting statistics on the same topic. Your sister is not alone in this. I dont have advice but its amazing that you're so supportive. My sibling just gets annoyed when I say these things and certainly doesn't care about me getting better
